title: Determination 45/1/173: south aisle extension to a listed church; escape by a fire exit door (Requirement B1, 1991 regulations)
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 1991 (as amended): Requirement B1 (means of escape)

facts.text: The determination is limited to Requirement B1; the Secretary of State states he has not considered whether the plans conform to any other relevant requirements.
The proposed work is an extension to a Grade II listed church with associated alterations, including removal of the southern wall.
The Department took full account of the likely occupant profile of the building and of its listed status when reaching its conclusion.

Determination: given the relatively low fire risk and the listed status, the fire exit door on the east elevation is a satisfactory alternative escape route, and the proposals comply with Requirement B1.
